notes.title: Shape Theory v1.4.2308
notes.content:
Hello! This update brings a number of requested improvements and bug fixes

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The In-game HUD now shows your progress in the current stage - the current level, total number of levels in the stage, and the number of challenges completed
[*] The stage selection screen now displays the current level and challenges for any stages in progress
[*] Added a skip hotkey. You can now skip levels instantly by pressing P (LT+RT on gamepad) instead of going to the pause menu
[/list]
[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the challenge icon does not reset when a level is reset
[*] Fixed incorrect number of challenges displayed in the stage complete screen
[/list]
